name: model-router
description: Routes each turn and each subagent to Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 by the kind of work: Sonnet for long work, Haiku for short jobs, Opus for planning, documents and repeated failures. Keeps a cost ledger.

mainRouting.title: Main loop routing
mainRouting.description: route: pick a model per turn; fixed: leave the main loop on the session's model.

classifier.title: Turn classifier
classifier.description: heuristic: keywords only (no extra call); hybrid: ask Haiku only when the heuristic is unsure; haiku: always ask Haiku.

base.title: Base tier
base.description: sonnet: long work runs on Sonnet (default); haiku: long work runs on Haiku and failures escalate.

docs.title: Documents
docs.description: delegate: the main loop hands documents for people to an Opus doc-writer subagent; switch: a document turn moves the main loop to Opus.

delegate.title: Register subagents
delegate.description: Register the doc-writer and test-runner agents and ask the main loop to use them.

subagentRouting.title: Route subagents
subagentRouting.description: Pick a model for subagents whose caller named none.

report.title: Per-turn report
report.description: turn: log the tier, tokens and estimated cost after each main turn (an SDK host receives it as ui_log); off: only /router-stats.
